verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for a cloud platform, but the evidence pack documents no OCI-native scheduler or recurring workflow capability. The Resource Manager 'import job' is a one-off migration action, not a recurring schedule. The community cronjob and Jenkins mentions are user-side workarounds running on their own VMs, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
